about: Shared probes for the free-text screen (T23-P1-C296, C300): text the assistant writes, such as a verdict's reason, a concern's text or a decider_ref. Core runs every entry through app.validation (tests/core/test_free_text_probes.py), and the CLI runs the same file through its screens. refuse: free text that must be refused (core: free_text_spans). send: free text that must be sent, so none is an over-refusal. roots_refuse: searched roots that must be refused (core: prose_value_spans). sequences: ordered screens of (field, text, expect) that the CLI runs in one process, so state left by one screen can't change the next; core runs each entry on its own (decider_ref: free_text_spans or role_ref_shape; reason and concern: free_text_spans; root: prose_value_spans). known_gaps: shapes a side gets wrong today, with the answer they should get (want), the side that gets it wrong (gap_in: both or cli) and why. Core's test checks that core still gets the other answer where the gap is core's too, so a fix has to move the entry.
